objective: Actual Gemini comparison with and without the existing experimental HoundOracle evidence pipeline
execution: One temporary Cloud Run Job, 1 vCPU, 2 GiB; existing narrowly scoped warhound-gemini service account; no IAM grants or public endpoint
infrastructure_change: Cloud Run API enabled for this authorized job because training quotas blocked prior execution
model_selection: First successful bounded smoke generation; record exact response modelVersion. No training VM required.
model_preflight: Up to four bounded smoke attempts, included in the 48-attempt cap; first successful model is fixed for all arms

arms: Oracle MLP at calibrated minimum .80, Gemini fallback on abstention

improvement_rule: If initial Oracle-first workflow loses factual decision accuracy, definitive coverage, model cost or p95 latency, screen fixed precision-logistic (.85 minimum calibrated correctness) and bypass candidates using development trace replay. Keep only a candidate with no development accuracy/coverage regression and no greater model-call count; bypass is the safe fallback.
selection_data: Development outcomes only; fresh confirmation outcomes never change the selected router
limits: Tiny pilot; no universal accuracy, all-in cost or live retrieval superiority claims. No counterfactual replay latency is presented as a live measurement. Full Gemini-agent tool-calling and Google Search grounding remain outside this pilot.
stable_production_policy: Preserved; router experiments are explicit opt-in for the historical supplied-evidence population
